catalog_policy: Do not add public-file-catalog rows until this file exists on a published Zenodo record.
public_note: This package was found in the old-physics/Gibbs lane, extracted, checksummed, and staged locally after the latest published Gibbs old-physics Zenodo version. It continues the Gibbs Volume I Paper 3 working tranche from printed p.125 through p.134 and updates the cumulative Paper 3 reader to pp.055-134.

targets.quality_label: Gibbs Volume I Paper 3 source-scan-backed working continuation: printed pp.125-134, cumulative pp.055-134
targets.coverage: The package contains an installment TeX/PDF/scan slice for printed pp.125-134 and a cumulative Paper 3 TeX/PDF/scan surface for pp.055-134, plus formula inventories, table inventories, scan maps, unit JSONL, compile QC, repair log, notation notes, method notes, and SHA256 manifest. Compile QC reports Inst_p125_134 as 8 PDF pages with 0 overfull and 0 underfull boxes, and Cum_p055_134 as 62 PDF pages with 0 overfull and 0 underfull boxes.
targets.findings: The repair log records a formulas-ledger rebuild for pp.115-124 because equations 191-198 were present in TeX/PDF but missing from the prior CSV, plus p125-p134 figure/layout repairs: Fig. 7 redrawn as four symmetric ruled wedges, Fig. 9 labels separated, current-range footnotes changed to asterisk markers, and Fig. 9 kept with its caption in a minipage.
targets.limitations: This is a source-scan-backed working tranche, not a complete Gibbs corpus and not a certified critical edition. The package notes that the separate `Onequilibriumhe00GibbA` witness did not cover collected pp.125-134, so the current scan baseline remains the collected-volume IA 400 ppi page-image PDF until the raw Vol. I JP2 witness is available in-session. OCR/witness layers are not textual authority.
targets.next_action: Create a new Gibbs old-physics Zenodo version, upload this ZIP and update the reader-facing Gibbs surface from pp.001-124 to pp.001-134 / Paper 3 pp.055-134 as appropriate, then regenerate the public file catalog, record page, status docs, and metadata.
